plainTranslation: A's identity meets B's identity. The conjunction fuses them - intense and inseparable.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
note: Imported from project-authored synastry matrix material. Source file was not copied into the repository.
summaryDeep:
You may recognize something familiar in this person right away. Maybe it is how they carry themselves, what they care about, or the way they handle life. Being around them can feel easy because you do not have to explain every little thing.

When this works, there is a relief in not having to explain yourself all the time. This person may understand why certain things matter to you, why you make the choices you do, or why you care as much as you do. You can feel seen in a way that feels simple and natural, like they already speak the language you're speaking.

The tricky part is that being alike can also bring out competition. You may both want to lead, both want to be seen, or both expect the other person to move out of the way. What felt familiar at first can start to feel crowded if nobody leaves room.

Let the similarity make you feel understood, not threatened.
